_comment: One-time snapshot of https://www.jw.org/en/languages/, used by update-langs.py to auto-fill englishName/label/langcode for newly-enabled languages without manual lookup. Regenerate with: curl -s https://www.jw.org/en/languages/ | python -c "..." (see scripts/update-langs.py). Languages added to the website after this snapshot will fall back to PLACEHOLDER_* values requiring manual entry.
